evals.name: close-youtube-tab
evals.prompt: close the youtube tab that was opened earlier
evals.expected_output: Claude should call eyes_list_chrome_tabs BEFORE eyes_close_tab, then use title matching to find the YouTube tab, not default to index 0

assertions.name: lists-tabs-before-close
assertions.description: Claude calls eyes_list_chrome_tabs before calling eyes_close_tab

assertions.name: uses-title-matching
assertions.description: Claude uses the title parameter or identifies the correct tab by title/URL before closing

assertions.name: no-blind-index-0
assertions.description: Claude does NOT call eyes_close_tab with default tab_index 0 without verification

evals.name: navigate-github-tab
evals.prompt: go to the issues page on my github tab
evals.expected_output: Claude should list tabs or check context first, identify which tab is GitHub, then navigate that specific tab

assertions.name: checks-context-or-lists-tabs
assertions.description: Claude calls eyes_list_chrome_tabs or eyes_context before eyes_navigate

assertions.name: targets-correct-tab
assertions.description: Claude identifies which tab index corresponds to GitHub before navigating

evals.name: close-all-except-current
evals.prompt: i have too many tabs open, close everything except the tab im currently reading
evals.expected_output: Claude should list all tabs, identify which one the user is reading (via context), then close others one by one, re-reading state between closes since indexes shift

assertions.name: lists-tabs-first
assertions.description: Claude calls eyes_list_chrome_tabs before any close operations

assertions.name: identifies-current-tab
assertions.description: Claude calls eyes_context or asks which tab the user is reading before closing

assertions.name: aware-of-index-shift
assertions.description: Claude either re-reads tab list between closes, closes from highest index first, or uses title matching to avoid index-shift bugs
